verdicts.reason: A uses the wide banner shape well. The red panel runs left to right with the headline and attribution, and the skyline sits at the right. Flaws: the headline is small, the author line is tiny, the headline and author are not aligned, and the skyline is cropped and walled off from the panel. B is a tiny centered copy of the original in a huge empty grey canvas. The text is illegible, the skyline is mangled and overlaps the panel, and the layout does not fit the format at all.
